name: Gulshan
description: Dhaka's premier diplomatic and corporate address, built around Gulshan Lake, with embassies, upscale dining and high-rise residences.

name: Banani
description: A prestigious residential-commercial district known for the Road 11 and Kemal Ataturk Avenue dining, retail and office strip.

name: Baridhara
description: The quiet diplomatic enclave of Dhaka: wide green streets, embassies and some of the city's most exclusive villas and apartments.

name: Bashundhara Residential Area
description: A large planned private township in north-east Dhaka with gated blocks, universities, hospitals and Jamuna Future Park nearby.

name: Dhanmondi
description: One of Dhaka's oldest planned neighbourhoods, centred on Dhanmondi Lake, with established residences, schools, clinics and boutiques.

name: Uttara
description: A planned satellite town in north Dhaka with numbered sectors, Metro Rail access and easy reach of Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.

name: Mirpur
description: A dense, fast-growing north-west Dhaka district centred on Mirpur 10 Circle, with Metro Rail access and affordable family housing.

name: Mohammadpur
description: A mature west Dhaka residential area around Town Hall and Tajmahal Road, with markets, schools and Ring Road access.

name: Tejgaon
description: A central business and light-industrial zone with Link Road offices, showrooms and warehouses close to Karwan Bazar and Farmgate.

name: Motijheel
description: Dhaka's central business district, home to Bangladesh Bank, banks, insurers and corporate head offices.

name: Wari
description: A heritage neighbourhood of Old Dhaka with colonial-era streets such as Rankin Street, mixing character homes and small businesses.

name: Paltan
description: A central Dhaka area around Purana Paltan and Topkhana Road, close to government offices, media houses and professional firms.

name: Lalmatia
description: A quiet, well-planned residential housing area in Mohammadpur-Dhanmondi, valued for its block layout and low traffic.

name: Khilgaon
description: A mixed residential area in east Dhaka around Taltola and Khilgaon Chowdhury Para with fast flyover links to the city centre.

name: Rampura
description: An east Dhaka neighbourhood around Rampura Bridge and Banasree, close to the Hatirjheel lakefront and the Bashundhara corridor.

name: Badda
description: A busy north-east Dhaka area along Badda Main Road and Link Road, with a large middle-income apartment market and many offices.

name: Agrabad
description: Chattogram's main commercial hub, with banks, trading houses and offices serving the country's principal seaport.

name: Panchlaish
description: A calm residential area of central Chattogram, known for tree-lined streets, family homes and easy city access.

name: Khulshi
description: A leafy, hilly residential area of Chattogram around Zakir Hossain Road, favoured for villas, apartments and a quieter lifestyle.

name: Sylhet City Center
description: The commercial heart of Sylhet around Zindabazar, with markets, offices and quick access to the Surma River and Shahjalal Dargah.

name: Shahjalal Upashahar
description: Sylhet's planned residential area with organised blocks, quiet roads, schools and a tea-country feel.

name: Rajshahi Central
description: The commercial centre of Rajshahi around Shaheb Bazar and Zero Point, with markets, banks and the city's main business addresses.

name: Boalia
description: A central Rajshahi area along the Padma River embankment, with civic offices, established housing and riverside promenades.

name: Khulna City Center
description: Khulna's business centre along KDA Avenue, with banks, offices and retail, and the main gateway city to the Sundarbans.

name: Sonadanga
description: A planned residential area of Khulna beside the central bus terminal, with growing apartment blocks and local markets.

name: Cox's Bazar Beach Area
description: The Cox's Bazar beachfront along Marine Drive and Laboni Beach, with sea-view condominiums, resorts and holiday homes.

name: Kolatoli
description: The Kolatoli beach strip in Cox's Bazar, home to the hotel-motel zone, seafood restaurants and holiday apartments a short walk from the sand.

name: Barishal City
description: The commercial centre of Barishal on Sadar Road near the Kirtankhola River, with markets, offices and family housing in the southern delta.
